description: This file contains tests related to Gateway Settings Storage in the OpenClaw project, including persisting default configurations, keychain entries, and last gateway connection details. It verifies correct copying of defaults and keychain data, manual and discovered gateway connection handling, and API key storage.

methods.name: bootstrapCopiesDefaultsToKeychainWhenMissing
methods.description: Tests that default values are copied to the keychain when they are missing.

methods.name: bootstrapCopiesKeychainToDefaultsWhenMissing
methods.description: Tests that keychain values are copied to defaults when defaults are missing.

methods.name: lastGateway_manualRoundTrip
methods.description: Verifies manual save and load of last gateway connection details.

methods.name: lastGateway_discoveredOverwritesManual
methods.description: Tests that a discovered gateway connection overwrites a manual one.

methods.name: lastGateway_migratesFromUserDefaults
methods.description: Ensures migration from legacy user defaults to new keychain storage happens correctly.

methods.name: talkProviderApiKey_genericRoundTrip
methods.description: Tests storing and retrieving an API key for a talk provider in the keychain.
